title: Affine form after setting one coordinate
statement: Let $a_0\in\mathbb{R}$, let $a\in\mathbb{R}^n$, let $i$ be a coordinate, let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, and let $s\in\{-1,1\}$. The affine linear form evaluated at the vector obtained from $x$ by setting coordinate $i$ to $s$ equals $a_0+\sum_{k\ne i}a_kx_k+a_is$.
